summary_en: Khmer stir-fried dishes cooked quickly in a wok with oil, garlic, and seasonings. Includes meat, fish, and noodle stir-fries. Key techniques: fry aromatics first, high heat, season with fish sauce and adjust taste at the end.

dishes.dish_name_en: Cha Khtuem Barang (Stir-fried Onion with Pork Ribs)
Cha Kroeung Sach Trei (Stir-fried Fish with Spice Paste)
